dct_description_sm: The GRID3 COD - Health Areas v8.0 dataset consists of health area boundaries with name, location, health zone, and other attributes for all the twenty-six provinces in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (COD). This operational dataset has not been fully validated by government officials or ministries. This current version supersedes the GRID3 COD - Health Areas v7.0. The following changes were made: - Added data for the provinces of Bas-Uele, Haut-Uele, Kwango, and Nord-Kivu - The data for Tanganyika was updated Suggested Dataset Citation: Center for Integrated Earth System Information (CIESIN), Columbia University, Ministère de la Santé Publique, Hygiène et Prévention, Democratic Republic of the Congo, and GRID3. 2025. GRID3 COD - Health Areas v8.0. New York: GRID3. URL. Accessed DAY-MONTH-YEAR.
